Script.name: playertracker
Script.script:
--[[ Player Tracker — port of Solao_Player_Tracker (MUSHclient) Sean Stoves, 2026-07-31
Captures every line of 'who', stores each player once keyed on name, keeps their clan / ranks / title / level and a last-seen stamp. The panel shows stats plus a clickable list.
Online = showed up in the most recent who sweep (seen >= last_who). A clan logout notice forces offline immediately, since a sweep can't tell someone left until the next who.
The MUSHclient version drew its own hotspots and scroll handling. Mudlet's MiniConsole gives us clickable links and a real scrollbar, so all of that machinery is gone. ]]
aardkit = aardkit or {} aardkit.pt = aardkit.pt or {}
local PT = aardkit.pt local U = aardkit.util.named("Players")
local CFG = U.load("playertracker", { players = {}, -- name:lower -> rec avg = { sum = 0, n = 0 }, last_who = 0, }) CFG.players = CFG.players or {} CFG.avg = CFG.avg or { sum = 0, n = 0 } CFG.last_who = CFG.last_who or 0
-- age out ancient records once per boot rather than never -- this table only -- ever grew before, one row forever per name ever seen in a who local STALE_DAYS = 90 local pruned = 0 for k, r in pairs(CFG.players) do if (r.seen or 0) > 0 and (os.time() - r.seen) > STALE_DAYS * 86400 then CFG.players[k] = nil pruned = pruned + 1 end end if pruned > 0 then U.save("playertracker", CFG) end
local view = {} local filter = "" local capturing = false
--- -- clan decoration -> short tag (punctuation-anchored, title-safe) ---
local DECOR = { { "|| BOOT ||", "boot" }, { "}HooK{", "hook" }, { ")light(", "light" }, { "(Seekers)", "seekers" }, { "[Emerald]", "emerald" }, { "[Ba'al]", "baal" }, { "-=Masaki=-", "masaki" }, { "winlobe", "twinlobe" }, { "|Watchmen|", "watchmen" }, { "TouchStone", "touchstone" }, { "imson|", "crimson" }, { "erdition", "perdition" }, { "aardian|", "gaardian" }, { "Loqui|", "loqui" }, { "/Pyre", "pyre" }, { "IMPERIUM", "imperium" }, { "ibution-", "retribution" }, { "[Loner]", "loner" }, { "|Wolf|", "wolf" }, { "}Tao{", "tao" }, { "/|\\", "druid" }, { "Rhabdo/", "rhabdo" }, -- Read off 293,554 real who rows: these four were being missed entirely. -- Amazon and Crusader put the clan name in the tag, so there's nothing to -- guess; Bard and Dragon are the two whose decoration carries no bracket. { "<*]AMAZON[*>", "amazon" }, { "=Crusader=", "crusader" }, { "o/~ Bard ~\\o", "bard" }, -- No Dragon entry on purpose: 'clist' has 27 clans and Dragon is not one of -- them, so nobody can be wearing it. It survives only inside other people's -- titles - "Erikson was kidnapped from -=*)Dragon(*=- by [Emerald]" - which -- is exactly the row that used to file him under it. }
local CLAN = { wolf = "The Wolf Administration", loner = "The Lone Adventurers", outcast = "The Outcast Clan of Shame", twinlobe = "The Fellowship of the Twin Lobes", watchmen = "The Watchmen of Aardwolf", seekers = "The Seekers", emerald = "The Emerald Knights", light = "The Order of Light", baal = "The Children of Ba'alzamon", hook = "The Hook Clan", bard = "Order of the Bard", crusader = "Crusaders of the Nameless One", xunti = "The Xunti Cult", imperium = "Clan Imperium", crimson = "The Crimson Horde", retribution = "Retribution", druid = "The Great Circle of Druids", amazon = "The Tribes of the Amazon", pyre = "The Soul Pyre", masaki = "Masaki Clan", rhabdo = "Dark Templars of Rhabdo Rana", perdition = "Knights of Perdition", loqui = "Loqui", gaardian = "The Midgaardian Publishing Group", tao = "The Creation of Tao", touchstone = "House of Touchstone", boot = "Boot Lyceum", }
local function clan_full(t) return CLAN[t or ""] or "" end
--- -- parse one who row ---
-- Counted, not guessed: (OPK) 62,239 rows, *AFK* 23,706, (Linkdead) 9,424, -- (HARDCORE) 6,781, then a long tail. Anything not peeled here becomes the -- player's name, which is how (traitor) and *[afk]* ended up in the database. local FLAGS = { "%*AFK%*", "%(OPK%)", "%(HARDCORE%)", "%(Linkdead%)", "%*%[AFK%]%*", "%(TRAITOR%)", "%(RAIDER%)", "%(WANTED%)", "%(Note%)", "%(Answer%)", "%(Editor%)", "%(DUEL%)", "%-Idle%-", }
-- The whotitle field is exactly 15 characters wide and may contain a ']' of its -- own - "[ (>^-^)>o=={x] ] Dazs ..." is a real row, and the old non-greedy -- "^%[(.-)%]" stopped at the inner one and made "]" the player's name. So the -- field is taken by position, not by searching for its terminator. local function parse(line) if #line < 18 or line:sub(1, 1) ~= "[" or line:sub(17, 17) ~= "]" then return nil end local info = U.trim(line:sub(2, 16)) local body = U.trim(line:sub(18)) if body == "" then return nil end
-- peel leading [Rank]/[Position] brackets and who flags, in any order, until -- the name is at the front. Clan tags sit at the tail, so this is safe. local ranks = "" local changed = true while changed do changed = false local rtag, rest = body:match("^%[([^%]]+)%]%s*(.*)$") if rtag then ranks = ranks == "" and U.trim(rtag) or (ranks .. " " .. U.trim(rtag)) body, changed = U.trim(rest), true end for _, f in ipairs(FLAGS) do local nb = body:gsub("^" .. f .. "%s*", "", 1) if nb ~= body then body, changed = nb, true end end end
-- RIGHTMOST decoration wins, because the clan tag trails the title and a -- title can name another clan. "Erikson was kidnapped from -=*)Dragon(*=- -- by [Emerald]" is Emerald, and taking the earliest match filed him under -- Dragon. It was doing that to live records: benitora read imperium and is -- Bard, cera read tao and is Amazon. local title, clan, cut = body, "", nil for _, d in ipairs(DECOR) do local p = nil local from = 1 while true do local q = body:find(d[1], from, true) if not q then break end p, from = q, q + 1 end if p and (not cut or p > cut) then cut, clan = p, d[2] end end if cut then title = U.trim(body:sub(1, cut - 1)) end
-- First word that reads like a name. A few clans put their decoration in -- front of the player rather than after, which left nothing before the cut. local name = title:match("^(%a+)%f[%A]") if not name then name = body:gsub("^%S+%s*", "", 1):match("^(%a+)%f[%A]") end if not name then return nil end
-- The bracket is the whotitle column, NOT a level - 37% of rows carry -- something like "*Daily Blessing*" or ":) :( ): (:". It reads -- "<lvl> <race> <class>" the other 63% of the time, so split that when it -- is there and leave the rest alone. It was being displayed as "Level:" -- either way, which is where "Level : SUPERHERO" came from. local lvl, race, cls = info:match("^(%d+)%s+(%S+)%s+(%S+)$") return { name = name, title = title, ranks = ranks, clan = clan, info = info, level = tonumber(lvl) or 0, race = race or "", class = cls or "" } end
--- -- online model ---
local function is_online(r) if r.on == false then return false end return (r.seen or 0) > 0 and r.seen >= (CFG.last_who or 0) end
local function ago(t) if not t then return "?" end return U.duration(os.time() - t) end
local function save() U.save("playertracker", CFG) end
--- -- capture ---
-- Only rows BETWEEN the header and 'Players found:' are who rows. Matching the -- shape alone let the prompt in: a 16-character whotitle makes -- "[*Daily Blessing*] [296/296hp 264/264mn 754/765mv 0qt 91tnl]" look exactly -- like one, and 24,158 of those in the logs became a player called '>'. -- One record, by name. Public because asserting on printed output is how you -- write a test that passes with the fix deleted - this file has done that. function PT.get(name) return CFG.players[tostring(name or ""):lower()] end
function PT.who_start() capturing = true CFG.last_who = os.time() -- sweep boundary: stamp before any row updates seen end
function PT.on_who(line) if not capturing then return end local p = parse(line) if not p then return end
local key = p.name:lower() local r = CFG.players[key] or {} r.name = p.name r.title = p.title if p.ranks ~= "" then r.ranks = p.ranks end -- keep a clan we already know if this row didn't show one, but never leave it -- nil - unclanned players would have no clan key at all r.clan = (p.clan ~= "" and p.clan) or r.clan or "" r.info = p.info -- level/race/class only when the whotitle actually held them; a custom -- title must not blank out what an earlier sweep learned if p.level > 0 then r.level, r.race, r.class = p.level, p.race, p.class end r.seen = os.time() r.on = true CFG.players[key] = r end
function PT.who_done(n) capturing = false -- empty sweep: no row fired to advance the boundary, so do it here and age -- everyone from the prior who to offline. Nothing else in CFG changed, so -- skip the disk write rather than serializing the whole (only ever growing) -- player table for a timestamp bump nobody but is_online() reads back if not n or n == 0 then CFG.last_who = os.time() PT.paint() return end if n and n > 0 then CFG.avg.sum = CFG.avg.sum + n CFG.avg.n = CFG.avg.n + 1 end PT.paint() save() end
function PT.clan_login(name) local key = name:lower() local r = CFG.players[key] or { name = name } r.name = r.name or name r.clan = r.clan or "" r.on, r.seen = true, os.time() CFG.players[key] = r PT.paint() save() end
function PT.clan_logout(name) local r = CFG.players[name:lower()] if r then r.on = false PT.paint() -- saved, not just painted. Without this a logout was lost on restart and -- the player came back remembered as online until the next who sweep. save() end end
--- -- stats + view ---
local function count_seen() local n = 0 for _ in pairs(CFG.players) do n = n + 1 end return n end
local function count_online() local n = 0 for _, r in pairs(CFG.players) do if is_online(r) then n = n + 1 end end return n end
local function avg_online() if CFG.avg.n == 0 then return 0 end return math.floor(CFG.avg.sum / CFG.avg.n + 0.5) end
-- the list shows who's on right now. A search is how you reach the rest of the -- database, so a live filter looks at everyone, online or not. local function build_view() view = {} local f = filter:lower() for _, r in pairs(CFG.players) do local show if f == "" then show = is_online(r) else local hay = (r.name .. " " .. (r.title or "") .. " " .. clan_full(r.clan)):lower() show = hay:find(f, 1, true) ~= nil end if show then view[#view + 1] = r end end table.sort(view, function(a, b) local ao, bo = is_online(a), is_online(b) if ao ~= bo then return ao end return (a.seen or 0) > (b.seen or 0) end) end
--- -- ui ---
local panel = aardkit.panel.new({ name = "players", title = "Player Tracker", width = 320, height = 380, x = "10px", y = "260px", fontSize = 9, })
PT.panel = panel
function PT.paint() if not panel.console then return end if not panel:visible() then return end -- clan logins fire this constantly, skip the Geyser work while hidden build_view()
local c = panel.console c:clear()
U.outw(c.name, string.format("<#c8d0dc>Seen: %d<r> <#3ad07a>Online: %d<r> <#8a93a8>Avg: %d<r>\n", count_seen(), count_online(), avg_online()))
if filter ~= "" then U.outw(c.name, "<#8a93a8>Filter: <#e0af68>" .. filter .. "<r> ") U.outLinkw(c.name, "<#f7768e>[clear]<r>", [[aardkit.pt.setfilter("")]], "Clear the filter", true) U.outw(c.name, "\n") end U.outw(c.name, "<#3a4a6b>" .. string.rep("-", 40) .. "<r>\n")
if #view == 0 then U.outw(c.name, filter ~= "" and "<#8a93a8>No matches.<r>\n" or "<#8a93a8>No one online - type 'who'.<r>\n") else for _, r in ipairs(view) do local on = is_online(r) U.outw(c.name, on and "<#3ad07a>*<r> " or "<#666666>*<r> ") U.outLinkw(c.name, (on and "<#e0e0e0>" or "<#8a93a8>") .. r.name .. "<r>", string.format("aardkit.pt.info(%q)", r.name), "Full record for " .. r.name, true) if r.clan and r.clan ~= "" then U.outw(c.name, " <#66ccff>(" .. r.clan .. ")<r>") end if not on then U.outw(c.name, " <#666666>" .. ago(r.seen) .. "<r>") end U.outw(c.name, "\n") end end
U.outw(c.name, "<#3a4a6b>" .. string.rep("-", 40) .. "<r>\n") if (CFG.last_who or 0) > 0 then U.outw(c.name, "<#8a93a8>Updated " .. os.date("%H:%M:%S", CFG.last_who) .. "<r>\n") else U.outw(c.name, "<#8a93a8>Never updated<r>\n") end end
function PT.setfilter(s) filter = U.trim(s) PT.paint() end
--- -- info + lookups ---
function PT.info(name) local r = CFG.players[(name or ""):lower()] if not r then U.note("No record for " .. tostring(name)) return end U.out("\n<#7aa2f7>--- " .. r.name .. " ---<r>") U.out("\n <#8a93a8>Title : <#c8d0dc>" .. (r.title or "?") .. "<r>") if r.ranks and r.ranks ~= "" then U.out("\n <#8a93a8>Ranks : <#c8d0dc>" .. r.ranks .. "<r>") end local cl = r.clan or "" U.out("\n <#8a93a8>Clan : <#c8d0dc>" .. (cl ~= "" and (clan_full(cl) .. " (" .. cl .. ")") or "none") .. "<r>") if (r.level or 0) > 0 then U.out("\n <#8a93a8>Level : <#c8d0dc>" .. r.level .. " <#8a93a8>" .. (r.race or "") .. " " .. (r.class or "") .. "<r>") end if (r.info or "") ~= "" then U.out("\n <#8a93a8>Who : <#c8d0dc>" .. r.info .. "<r>") end -- whatever a finger added, which who can't reach if (r.frace or "") ~= "" or (r.tier or "") ~= "" then U.out("\n <#8a93a8>Finger: <#c8d0dc>" .. (r.frace or "") .. " " .. (r.fclass or "") .. ((r.tier or "") ~= "" and (" <#8a93a8>tier <#c8d0dc>" .. r.tier) or "") .. "<r>") end if (r.remort or "") ~= "" then U.out("\n <#8a93a8>Remort: <#c8d0dc>" .. r.remort .. "<r>") end if (r.clanfull or "") ~= "" then U.out("\n <#8a93a8>Clan : <#c8d0dc>" .. r.clanfull .. "<r>") end U.out("\n <#8a93a8>Status: " .. (is_online(r) and "<#3ad07a>online" or "<#8a93a8>offline") .. "<r> <#8a93a8>(seen " .. ago(r.seen) .. " ago)<r>\n") end
-- machine-readable lookup for the other ported plugins (SolaoBot uses this) function PT.lookup(name) local r = CFG.players[(name or ""):lower()] if not r then return nil end return { name = r.name, seen = r.seen or 0, online = is_online(r), clan = r.clan or "" } end
local function do_find(term) term = U.trim(term):lower() if term == "" then U.warn("Usage: pt find <text>") return end local hits = {} for _, r in pairs(CFG.players) do local hay = (r.name .. " " .. (r.title or "") .. " " .. clan_full(r.clan)):lower() if hay:find(term, 1, true) then hits[#hits + 1] = r end end table.sort(hits, function(a, b) return (a.seen or 0) > (b.seen or 0) end) U.note(#hits .. " match" .. (#hits == 1 and "" or "es") .. " for '" .. term .. "':") for _, r in ipairs(hits) do U.out(string.format("\n %s%-14s<r> <#8a93a8>%-26s %s ago<r>", is_online(r) and "<#3ad07a>" or "<#8a93a8>", r.name, clan_full(r.clan), ago(r.seen))) end echo("\n") end
local function do_export() local path = U.datafile("players.csv") local f = io.open(path, "w") if not f then U.err("Can't write " .. path) return end f:write("name,clan,ranks,level,online,last_seen_epoch,title\n") for _, r in pairs(CFG.players) do f:write(string.format('%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%d,"%s"\n', r.name, r.clan or "", (r.ranks or ""):gsub(",", ";"), (r.info or ""):gsub(",", ";"), tostring(is_online(r)), r.seen or 0, (r.title or ""):gsub('"', "'"))) end f:close() U.ok("Exported " .. count_seen() .. " players -> " .. path) end
--- -- commands ---
function PT.cmd(arg) local verb, rest = U.split_verb(arg) -- 'x opacity 200' where somebody looks for it, rather than only -- 'panel x opacity 200'. One line; core does the work. if aardkit.panel.verb("players", verb, rest) then return end
if verb == "toggle" then panel:toggle() if panel:visible() then PT.paint() end -- repaint on show; who/clan events skip painting while hidden now
elseif verb == "find" then do_find(rest)
elseif verb == "filter" then PT.setfilter(rest) U.ok(rest == "" and "Filter cleared." or ("Filter: " .. rest))
elseif verb == "info" then PT.info(U.trim(rest))
elseif verb == "online" then U.note("Online now (" .. count_online() .. "):") local names = {} for _, r in pairs(CFG.players) do if is_online(r) then names[#names + 1] = r end end table.sort(names, function(a, b) return a.name < b.name end) for _, r in ipairs(names) do U.out("\n <#3ad07a>" .. r.name .. "<r> <#8a93a8>(" .. clan_full(r.clan) .. ")<r>") end echo("\n")
elseif verb == "count" then U.note(count_seen() .. " tracked, " .. count_online() .. " online, avg " .. avg_online() .. " a time.")
elseif verb == "export" then do_export()
elseif verb == "clear" then if U.trim(rest) == "yes" then CFG.players = {} PT.paint(); save() U.ok("Database cleared.") else U.warn("Wipes ALL tracked players. Type: pt clear yes") end
elseif verb == "dock" then panel:setmode("dock") elseif verb == "embed" then panel:setmode("embed")
else U.help("Player Tracker", { { "pt toggle", "show or hide the panel" }, { "pt", "show/hide the panel" }, { "pt find <text>", "search name / clan / title" }, { "pt filter <text>", "filter the panel list (blank clears)" }, { "pt info <name>", "full record for one player" }, { "pt online", "list who's online now" }, { "pt count", "quick totals" }, { "pt export", "dump players.csv" }, { "pt clear yes", "wipe the database" }, { "pt dock | embed", "" }, { "pt opacity <0-255>", "how solid this window is; 'default' follows the shared setting" }, { "" }, { "Click a name in the panel for its record. Online = in the most" }, { "recent 'who'; a clan logout marks offline right away." }, }) end end
PT.paint() --- -- finger -- -- 'finger' is slow and answers about one player, which is the whole reason this -- module sweeps 'who' instead. So nothing here SENDS one: it reads the block -- when you run it yourself, and takes the parts 'who' can't give. -- -- What who gives is a 15-character column: an abbreviated race and class, and -- 37% of the time a custom title instead of a level. finger gives the real -- level, the spelled-out race and class, the tier, the remort chain and the -- clan by name - and the clan by name is the one that settles the players whose -- decoration we don't recognise. -- -- Deliberately NOT stored: email, web address and "is from". They are on screen -- because you asked for them, they are personal, and a player database is not -- the place for other people's contact details. ---
-- Clan names as finger writes them, longest first so "The Children of -- Ba'alzamon" is tested before anything that could sit inside it. Matched as a -- substring of the whole line rather than split on " of ", because the RANK -- contains " of " too - "X is a Trolloc of The Children of Ba'alzamon." -- The MUD's own table, straight off 'clist': full name -> short name, all 27 -- live clans. Longest first, so a name that contains another is tested first. -- -- Matched as a substring of the whole line rather than split on " of ", because -- the RANK contains " of " too - "X is a Trolloc of The Children of Ba'alzamon." local CLANFULL = { { "The Fellowship of the Twin Lobes", "twinlobe" }, { "The Midgaardian Publishing Group", "gaardian" }, { "Crusaders of the Nameless One", "crusader" }, { "Dark Templars of Rhabdo Rana", "rhabdo" }, { "The Children of Ba'alzamon", "baal" }, { "The Great Circle of Druids", "druid" }, { "The Outcast Clan of Shame", "outcast" }, { "The Watchmen of Aardwolf", "watchmen" }, { "The Tribes of the Amazon", "amazon" }, { "The Wolf Administration", "wolf" }, { "The Lone Adventurers", "loner" }, { "Knights of Perdition", "perdition" }, { "House of Touchstone", "touchstone" }, { "The Emerald Knights", "emerald" }, { "The Creation of Tao", "tao" }, { "The Order of Light", "light" }, { "The Crimson Horde", "crimson" }, { "Order of the Bard", "bard" }, { "The Xunti Cult", "xunti" }, { "The Soul Pyre", "pyre" }, { "The Hook Clan", "hook" }, { "Clan Imperium", "imperium" }, { "Boot Lyceum", "boot" }, { "Masaki Clan", "masaki" }, { "The Seekers", "seekers" }, { "Retribution", "retribution" }, { "Loqui", "loqui" }, }
local finger = nil -- name being read, or nil when not inside a block
function PT.finger_start(name, state) finger = { name = name, state = tostring(state or ""):lower() } end
function PT.finger_done() if not finger then return end local f = finger finger = nil local key = f.name:lower() local r = CFG.players[key] or { name = f.name } r.name = r.name or f.name if f.level then r.level = f.level end if f.race then r.frace = f.race end if f.class then r.fclass = f.class end if f.tier then r.tier = f.tier end if f.remort then r.remort = f.remort end if f.stats and next(f.stats) then r.stats = r.stats or {} for k, v in pairs(f.stats) do r.stats[k] = v end end -- Not everyone is in a clan, and finger is the only source that can say so. -- who infers a clan from title decoration, so it can only ever ADD one - a -- player who leaves keeps the old tag forever. A finger block with no -- membership line at all is positive evidence of none, so it clears. -- -- "No tag" and "no line" are not the same thing: a clan we haven't mapped -- yet gives a line but no tag, and must not wipe the tag who worked out. -- That case lands in the first branch, because an unmapped line still fills -- clanfull - which is why the flag this used to carry decided nothing and -- came back out. if f.clanfull then r.clanfull = f.clanfull if f.clan ~= "" then r.clan = f.clan end else -- no membership line in the block at all r.clan, r.clanfull = "", nil end r.clan = r.clan or "" r.fingered = os.time() if f.state == "online" then r.on, r.seen = true, os.time() elseif f.state == "offline" then r.on = false end CFG.players[key] = r PT.paint() save() end
-- "Level 175 Male Dark elf Sorcerer (Tier 9+32)." -- Race can be two words, tier can carry a superhero count, and a rank tag can -- sit AFTER the class - "Tigran Ninja [Advisor]" is a real one. function PT.finger_level(lvl, rest, tier) if not finger then return end finger.level = tonumber(lvl) or 0 finger.tier = U.trim(tostring(tier or "")) rest = U.trim(tostring(rest or ""):gsub("%s*%[[^%]]*%]", "")) local words = {} for w in rest:gmatch("%S+") do words[#words + 1] = w end if #words >= 3 then finger.class = words[#words] finger.race = table.concat(words, " ", 2, #words - 1) end end
-- whois: a third source, and the only one carrying career totals. -- -- [181 T0 Sprite War] Solao Bajiuik [C] (Male Blacksmith) -- -- Level, tier, race and class in one 17-character field - wider than who's 15, -- so the who-row trigger cannot see it. The clan line is worded exactly as -- finger words it, so PT.finger_is already handles it once a block is open. function PT.whois_start(lvl, tier, race, cls, name) finger = { name = name, state = "" } finger.level = tonumber(lvl) or 0 finger.tier = tostring(tier or "") finger.race = race finger.class = cls end
-- "Quests Complete : [ 179] Quests Failed: [ 9] Gquests Won: [ 0]" -- -- Scraped generically rather than with a pattern per statistic. The block is -- not fixed: Solao's carries Trivia Points and Quest Points where Erikson's -- carries PK Victories, and the columns move with the widest number. Fifteen -- brittle patterns would go stale the first time Aardwolf adds a line; this -- keeps whatever is there under the name the MUD gave it. function PT.whois_stat(line) if not finger then return end finger.stats = finger.stats or {} for label, val in line:gmatch("(%a[%a%s]-)%s*:%s*%[%s*([^%]]-)%s*%]") do -- a fresh local: the loop variable is const in 5.4, which the dev -- harness runs on even though Mudlet's LuaJIT would allow the assignment local k = U.trim(label) if k ~= "" then finger.stats[k] = tonumber(val) or val end end end
function PT.finger_remort(list) if not finger then return end finger.remort = U.trim(tostring(list or "")) end
-- Every "<name> is ..." line in the block. Only the clan one is kept. function PT.finger_is(line) if not finger then return end for _, c in ipairs(CLANFULL) do if line:find(c[1], 1, true) then finger.clanfull, finger.clan = c[1], c[2] return end end -- Unknown clan: keep the words rather than drop them. "is a Savant of -- <something>" is still worth having, and it's how the table above grows. local tail = line:match("%sis an?%s+.-%sof%s+(.+)%.$") if tail and #tail < 60 then -- clanfull only, never the tag: this string is unverified, and letting -- it set a tag would let any "X is a friend of Y." line overwrite a -- clan who had already got right finger.clanfull, finger.clan = U.trim(tail), "" end end
aardkit.register("pt", "who-sweep player database", PT.cmd)
